tracks.semantics: measured pair matches, seed candidates, PnP candidates/masks and new triangulation candidates including rejections

provenance.known_intrinsics: declared known K; no pose truth

config.scope: stage6 minimal PnP/incremental only; no BA, stage7 or new benchmark
config.intrinsics_protocol: known distortion-free K per image, explicitly supplied calibration input; DTU pose/scale/reference points never used in reconstruction
config.preprocessing: reuse fixed local stage3 Pillow bilinear 800x600 images and zero-based pixel-center affine A; K_processed=A*K_original
config.normalized_threshold_rule: pixel threshold divided by mean fx/fy across both images; exact K inverse includes skew
config.homography_gate: conservative ambiguity warning/rejection, not proof of planarity or rotation
config.pose_hypotheses: decomposeEssentialMat, enumerate (R1,+t),(R1,-t),(R2,+t),(R2,-t); choose most finite dual-positive E inliers, tie lower median max-view reprojection
config.triangulation: explicit batched DLT SVD; save all candidate points/depths/angles/errors/masks; filter dual-positive, sufficient angle, both-view reprojection
config.scale: camera1 I/0; camera2 world-to-camera R/t with norm(t)=1; no metric scale recovery
config.device: CPU OpenCV SIFT/RANSAC and NumPy SVD; no model load or GPU allocation
config.registration_order: manifest order excluding fixed seed; one attempt per view; no adaptive selection/retries
config.track_conflicts: reject ambiguous keypoint or landmark identities in both directions
config.existing_poses_and_points: immutable; no BA or pose refinement
